books.title: The Diary of a Madman
books.author: Nikolai Gogol
books.synopsis: A lowly St. Petersburg clerk, hopelessly infatuated with his director's daughter, starts eavesdropping on the lapdogs he believes are writing letters to each other, then declares himself the missing King of Spain and marches off to be crowned. His journal entries grow ever more deranged and the dates dissolve into nonsense as the delusion carries him, finally, into an asylum he mistakes for the Spanish royal court.

books.title: Ethan Brand
books.author: Nathaniel Hawthorne
books.synopsis: Eighteen years after walking away from his lime-kiln to search the world for the Unpardonable Sin, Ethan Brand returns to find it was in his own heart all along: the cold, remorseless intellect that turned other souls into experiments. He faces down a jeering crowd of drunks, a showman with a diorama, and the father of the girl he ruined, then climbs onto the kiln at dawn and gives himself to the fire, leaving only a skeleton with a heart burned to marble.

books.title: Pierre et Jean
books.author: Guy de Maupassant
books.synopsis: A family friend leaves his entire fortune to the younger of two brothers, Jean, and the news curdles into suspicion in the mind of the elder, Dr. Pierre, who becomes convinced the bequest proves their mother once had an affair and that Jean is not their father's son. Pierre's jealousy and moral disgust wreck his own life as he circles the truth, needling his mother and brother until the family fractures, and he finally exiles himself to sea as a ship's doctor rather than live with what he's uncovered.

books.title: The Nether World
books.author: George Gissing
books.synopsis: In the slums of Clerkenwell, orphaned Jane Snowdon is rescued from her abusive guardians and taken in by her secretly wealthy grandfather Michael Snowdon, who wants her to spend his fortune on the poor. He dies before signing a new will, jeweler Sidney Kirkwood marries the embittered, acid-scarred Clara Hewett instead of Jane, and Clara's brother Bob dies fleeing arrest for coining forged money — leaving Jane to reject inherited money and marriage alike for a life of quiet, grinding toil among the poor she loves.

books.title: The Odd Women
books.author: George Gissing
books.synopsis: In late-Victorian London, sisters Alice and Virginia Madden scrape by as impoverished spinsters while their younger sister Monica marries the dull, jealous Widdowson out of sheer economic desperation. Meanwhile the fiercely independent Rhoda Nunn, who runs a school training women for clerical work, wrestles with her attraction to the charming but unreliable Everard Barfoot, testing whether a modern woman can have both principle and love.

books.title: Esther Waters
books.author: George Moore
books.synopsis: A servant girl seduced and abandoned by a fellow footman fights to keep her illegitimate son alive against workhouse threats, baby farms, and a lifetime of grinding domestic drudgery, while the racing-and-betting world that ruined her keeps dragging her back in.

books.title: Almayer's Folly
books.author: Joseph Conrad
books.synopsis: A failed Dutch trader rots away on the Borneo river of Sambir, chasing a dead man's rumor of gold while his half-Malay daughter Nina falls for the Balinese prince Dain Maroola. When Dutch gunboats close in on Dain and Nina chooses to flee with him, Almayer is left alone in his unfinished house, drowning his ruin in opium and denial.

books.title: The Beast in the Jungle
books.author: Henry James
books.synopsis: John Marcher confides to May Bartram his lifelong conviction that some rare, terrible fate is crouched in wait for him, and she quietly commits herself to watching beside him for it. Years pass in London as the two grow old together on the strength of this shared secret, Marcher too absorbed in his own impending doom to notice what he is actually failing to do. Only after May dies does Marcher grasp, standing at her grave, that the catastrophe he spent his life bracing for was the very love he let pass him by.

books.title: The Shepherd of the Hills
books.author: Harold Bell Wright
books.synopsis: A mysterious stranger calling himself Daniel Howitt settles among the Ozark backwoods folk, tutoring the wild, spirited Sammy Lane and befriending the giant-strong Young Matt while nursing a private grief that ties him to the mountain's darkest legend. As Sammy is torn between Matt's rough devotion and a smooth-talking suitor from the city, old secrets about a dead outlaw and a broken family surface, forcing the shepherd to confront the very tragedy that drove him into hiding.

books.title: Under Western Eyes
books.author: Joseph Conrad
books.synopsis: A St. Petersburg student, Razumov, betrays a fellow student who has just assassinated a government minister, then finds himself recruited as a spy among Genevan revolutionary exiles — including the dead man's sister, who has no idea who really doomed her brother.

books.title: Beau Geste
books.author: P.C. Wren
books.synopsis: When their aunt's priceless sapphire, the 'Blue Water,' vanishes, three brothers each vanish in turn to shield the others from suspicion, enlisting under false names in the French Foreign Legion. Years later a fellow officer arrives at a desert garrison to find every man of its besieged fort dead at his post and the fort's commander stabbed with no killer in sight, and pulls at the thread that unravels the brothers' sacrifice.

books.title: The Pathfinder
books.author: James Fenimore Cooper
books.synopsis: On the shores of Lake Ontario during the French and Indian War, frontier scout Natty Bumppo escorts Sergeant Dunham's daughter Mabel through hostile wilderness to her father's remote fort, and finds himself falling for her even as a scheming quartermaster and a young ship's master vie for her hand. When treachery among the garrison exposes a spy in their midst, Pathfinder must choose between the woman he loves and the solitary life of the forest he can never leave.
